cases.title: Form fill popup menu activation on saved field access
cases.description: Verify that accessing a form field that has saved data in the form manager activates the form fill popup menu.

cases.title: Save form data from edit menu
cases.description: Verify that a form's data is correctly saved when initiated from the edit menu.

cases.title: Discard saving form data from dialog box
cases.description: Verify that the user can successfully discard saving a form's data when prompted by the dialog box.

cases.title: Choose never saving form data from dialog box
cases.description: Verify that the user can choose the option to never save a form's data from the dialog box.

cases.title: Never for this site persistence across visits
cases.description: Verify that selecting 'never for this site' in the popup dialog saves the preference so that returning to the site never prompts or saves form data again.

cases.title: New field value offered in prefill
cases.description: Verify that if a new value for a field is added to the Form Manager, it is offered as an option when prefilling that field later.

cases.title: Deleted data excluded from prefill
cases.description: Verify that if data is deleted within the Form Manager, it is no longer shown as an option when prefilling a form.

cases.title: Deletion rollback on cancel
cases.description: Verify that if data deletion is initiated in the Form Manager and cancel is clicked, the data is not deleted and persists.

opinions.feedback: All proposed test cases successfully cover the provided requirements with distinct scenarios, clear risk assessment, and proper testability. No blockers found.
All cases and expected behaviors accurately correspond to the specified requirements.

analysis.analysis:
R-038: Testable behavior is popup menu activation on accessing a saved form field. Boundaries include fields with vs without saved data. Normal path: access saved field, popup appears. Abnormal path: access unsaved field, no popup. Ambiguity: definition of 'accessed' (focus vs click vs typing).

R-039: Testable behavior is saving form data via the edit menu. Normal path: invoke edit menu command to save. Abnormal path: invoke edit menu when no active form data exists.

R-040: Testable behavior is discarding save action from the dialog box. Normal path: trigger save dialog, select discard. Abnormal path: closing dialog without explicit action.

R-041: Testable behavior is choosing 'never save' for a form from the dialog box. Normal path: select 'never' option. Abnormal path: selecting save instead.

R-042: Testable behavior is persisting 'never for this site' across sessions. Normal path: select never, return to site, ensure no prompt and no save. Ambiguity: scope of 'site' (domain vs origin).

R-043: Testable behavior is offering newly added field values during prefill. Normal path: add new value, access field, verify value is in prefill options. Abnormal path: add value but fail to commit.

R-044: Testable behavior is excluding deleted manager data from prefill options. Normal path: delete data in manager, access field, verify absence in options.

R-045: Testable behavior is rollback of deletion upon clicking cancel. Normal path: initiate deletion in Form Manager, click cancel, verify data persists. Abnormal path: clicking confirm instead of cancel.
